anchor: Which heavenly warrior angel shrugs off enchantments and fear, sees through disguises, and reappears in its home realm after being slain?

What spell lets me keep focus for up to ten minutes and deals 6d10 magical harm to anyone who walks into its area unless they dodge?
Which winter monster can blast a 30-foot circle of victims so they can't move until their next turn, and frighten the crowd?
What frost beast can dash half its speed and attack, and also cast a spell that scares everyone nearby, but only once per turn?
Which wyrm that can breathe underwater also spews a long corrosive line and senses nearby enemies without needing to see them?
What huge chaotic evil creature makes three claw attacks, each adding corrosive harm, and has a recharging breath weapon?

How much extra harm does a summoned burning sword deal for each spell slot level above the second I use?
Which large monster digs through solid stone, leaving a ten-foot-wide passage, and bites hard enough to grab prey?
My character got hit by a caustic jet in a long narrow line, and then got seized by a bite. What monster does that?
Which 3rd-level spell makes foes in a cone drop what they hold and run from me, and lets them recover if they end a turn hidden from me?
What spell needs a white plume as a material, requires me to keep focus for up to a minute, and makes foes flee?
Which 6th-level spell lets me touch a willing ally so they can see through illusions and invisibility within 120 feet for an hour?
What spell requires at least 25 gold worth of fungal dust, consumed during casting, and lasts an hour on a touched ally?
Which enormous sea predator can only breathe underwater, moves slowly on land, and gets an edge on bites against creatures already hurt?
Is there an undersea beast whose two chomps each do 3d10 plus 6 stabbing harm?

Which huge walking greenery is hurt more by flames and shrugs off blunt and stabbing hits?

What druid focus gives +2 to attack rolls and spell attacks, and can spend six charges to raise a thorny barrier?
Which wyrm can shift shape into a beast or humanoid at will, and also unleash a booming blast that leaves foes unable to hear?

Which frost wyrm can glide across icy surfaces without making checks and ignore snow's slowing effect?
What wyrm breathes a 60-foot cone of frigid harm and makes three strikes per turn?
Which backpack has a central compartment holding up to 500 pounds and always weighs 5 pounds no matter what's inside?
What happens if I place my magic knapsack inside another magical sack or folding rug-door, and who gets pulled away?
Which high-level feat lets me add or subtract a 2d4 roll to a nearby creature's d20 check within 60 feet?

What cloak lets me teleport a fair distance once per day and leaves a smoky cloud where I was?

Which rare drink grants me the ability to see distant places as if I were standing there, without needing to focus?
What sort of rare vial has an eyeball floating in yellow fluid that disappears when opened, and what does drinking it do?
How often may a nature-bonded caster take an animal body, and how many uses come back after a short rest?
At what druid level can my animal form have wings, and how long does each transformation last, given half my level in hours?
